sloka: प्राप्तचारित्रसन्देहा मम प्रतिमुखे स्थिता ।दीपो नेत्रातुरस्येव प्रतिकूला ऽसि मे दृढम् ।। ६.११८.१७ ।।
transliteration: prāptacāritrasandehā mama pratimukhe sthitā ।dīpo netrāturasyeva pratikūlā 'si me dṛḍham ।। 6.118.17 ।।

translations.english: "In the event of doubtful conduct also you are standing firmly like a glowing lamp for me suffering from sore eyes and disagreeable to me."
